follow-up time: 1 year before and after policy implementation
exposure: inductions between 39 and 41 weeks with an unfavorable cervix
elective inductions at less than 39 weeks gestation
cohort: All deliveries greater than or equal to 37 weeks gestation 1 year prior to and after implementation of an induction policy
finding: Implementation of a policy prohibiting elective inductions at less than 39 weeks gestation and inductions between 39 and 41 weeks with an unfavorable cervix was associated with a reduction in elective inductions without changes in maternal or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: An institutional policy limiting elective inductions did not affect rates of Cesarean deliveries.
